facts.business: Nelcast manufactures iron castings for commercial vehicles, tractors, and other automotive applications in India and exports to global markets.

capacity_or_capex.item: Pedapariya facility ramp-up for new business wins

guidance_or_targets.statement: Domestic demand, particularly in the commercial vehicle segment, is expected to remain supportive, while export markets are showing encouraging signs of recovery.
